hook: Ninety-nine historic volumes reveal personal narratives that history almost forgot across Virginia.

sections.voiceover: Ninety-nine historic volumes reveal personal narratives that history almost forgot across Virginia.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of archival records in the Library of Virginia.

sections.voiceover: Library of Virginia completed a five-year archival preservation effort for Virginia Untold: The African American Narrative. Volumes originate from nearly 60 localities statewide. Lydia Neuroth traveled to Southwest Virginia for courthouse archiving. Where did Lydia Neuroth find these fragile registry pages?
sections.visual_cue: Archivist handling historical documents in Virginia

sections.voiceover: Except these records span nearly 60 localities statewide.
Library of Virginia published ninety-nine digitized Free Negro Registers online. Lydia Neuroth uncovered hidden entries across Southwest Virginia.
